verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page claims '2,000+ page support', which covers thousand-page documents. Every processing endpoint offers an async mode with SDK polling helpers and webhooks for production workloads, which addresses the timeout concern for long jobs. Missing for 10: any documented file-size limits or multi-gigabyte handling, explicit guarantees or error behavior against silent truncation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-document reliability.
